g.text: Seven steps. People approve; the AI agent checks, routes and verifies.
dropdowns from the mapping sheet only
checklist against the mapping sheet and the
the Owner is mailed only to decide
the risk and the access level
membership and a one-time TAP for the joiner;
the agent checks the result in Entra
exactly the roles in the response document;
the agent checks them in Azure
no wait for the joiner's sign-in
the team gets the exact gap
completion mail to the requester, with Security,
joiner: access ready at the Enterprise ID mail
* v2.1, off until approved: after both approvals the agent itself creates the user, group and
membership, mails the one-time TAP, and assigns allow-listed roles - never admin roles.
Whatever it cannot do goes to the team, and the agent checks the team's report.
- Mapping sheet changed: the review runs again; a changed group or role needs both approvals again.
- Review failed 3 times: Failed, needs developer; an Operator resumes it after the fix.
- Each step has an SLA: a reminder at the SLA, escalation to the manager at twice the SLA.
